title: Plan OD-9/R1005: a stage whose input is absent refuses instead of understating
body:
Plan for **OD-9**/`R1005`, written by the steward worker the unattended delivery driver dispatched on base `run/web`. Slug `refuse-on-missing-artifact`, `covers: [R1005]`, 393 lines.

A stage whose input is absent must **refuse** rather than quietly produce an understated answer — a missing artifact currently reads downstream as "nothing found" rather than "nothing looked at".

One **LOW** uncertainty is filed in `docs/BACKLOG.md` in this same commit; the plan proceeds on its recorded default and the oracle reviews it next cycle, per AGENTS.md.

Opened by the server-side `open-pr` workflow at the driver's request (ESC-50).
